metadata.description: Starter Cultures by MSP Culture: installable AI workflows for MSPs and IT operators. Each one is a Claude plugin with a guided setup.

plugins.name: meeting-follow-through
plugins.description: MSP Culture Starter Culture. Every action item from your recorded meetings, captured and tracked: Plaud recordings matched to your calendar, a daily recap, and a weekly open-loops review.

plugins.name: helpdesk-resume-builder
plugins.description: MSP Culture Starter Culture. A tailored, ATS-safe resume for MSP and IT technician roles, Tier 1 through Tier 3: builds an experience database, tailors to each job posting, checks it like an ATS would, and preps you for the interview.
